newsitem.title: USA: Canyon Resources expands CR Minerals unit.
newsitem.headline: Canyon Resources expands CR Minerals unit.

text.p: Canyon Resources Corp said Monday its CR Minerals Corp subsidiary has purchased the assets of American Pumice Co, an existing pumice production facility in Santa Fe, N.M., for undisclosed terms.
The Santa Fe operation produces Navajo Brand volcanic glass products for water filtration, hand soap, polishing, electronic, metal and plastic finishing, pottery and other markets.

New products from this plant, as well as from CR Minerals' existing diatomite plant in Fernley, Nev., will be marketed as environmentally superior, low-crystalline products to many of the same customers worldwide, using many of the same distributors.

"With the planned expansion of production capabilities at the Santa Fe plant and pursuit of new products and markets, CR Minerals' objectives are to generate an annual cash flow of $5 million to $6 million from its industrial minerals business in the next few years," said Gary C. Huber, president of CR Minerals. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
